test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Sujata buys 9 apples and 8 mangoes for ₹276. When the cost of an apple is decreased by 10% and that of a mango remains the same, then the cost of 5 apples and 10 mangoes is ₹210. What is the original cost of 4 apples and 3 mangoes?
solution:
Given:

The cost of 9 apples and 8 mangoes = Rs. 276

% decrease in the price of apple = 10%

The price of mango remains the same.

The new cost of 5 apples and 10 mangoes = Rs. 210

Calculation:

Let the cost of 1 apple and 1 mango be x and y respectively

The changed price of 1 apple and 1 mando is 0.9x and y respectively

Then, according to the question:

9x + 8y = 276 ----(i)

(0.9)5x + 10y = 210

⇒ 4.5x + 10y = 210 ----(ii)

By multiplying (i) by 0.5 and (ii) by 1 and subtracting (i) from (ii)

⇒ 10y - 0.5[8y]= (210) - (276 × 0.5)

⇒ 6y = 210 - 138

⇒ 6y = 72

⇒ y = 12

Putting the value of y in (i)

⇒ x = 20

∴ The price of 4 apples and 3 mangoes is 80 + 36 = Rs. 116

**The answer is 116.**
